name: Rotstadt Brigade '58
description: The main ultras group behind Rotstadion's south stand, known for continuous 90-minute chanting and a strict no-sitting policy in their section.

name: Curva Vento Nord
description: Organized around Portovento's north curve, this group is famous for tifo displays that unfurl across the entire stand in under thirty seconds.

name: Nordhavn Løver
description: A small but fiercely dedicated group that travels to nearly every away fixture regardless of distance or division.

name: Frente Cantera
description: One of the oldest organized supporter groups in the region, rooted in the same stonemasons' guild culture as the club itself.

name: Zvijezda Fanatici
description: Renowned across Europe for the scale and intensity of their pyro displays and for organizing supporter convoys to every away match.
